style.styleTitle: Homcom Set of 2 2ft Pre-Lit Christmas Stake Trees
style.toneOfVoice: Add festive charm to your outdoor space with this 2-piece lighted Christmas tree set. Featuring a compact tree body, green PVC tips and a ground-insert design, these trees are easy to place in your garden. Each Xmas tree is pre-lit with colourful LEDs in a steady-on mode and powered by 3 AA batteries (not included), while the manually expandable tips make setup simple. With an IP44 rating and PVC, these trees create a cheerful and convenient holiday display. 2-piece set with a compact ground-insert design, featuring 60 cm tree bodies and 16 cm stakes for easy outdoor placement. Colourful LED lights create a cheerful, festive glow in steady-on mode. Battery-powered with 3 AA batteries per Christmas tree (not included), requiring no nearby power outlet for flexible decorating. The IP44-rated design is suitable for outdoor holiday decorating. Single-section trunks and manually expandable tips make setup and shaping simple. Designed for outdoor use, suitable for gardens, patios, porches and yards to create a festive Christmas atmosphere. Colour: Green. Light Colour: Colourful. Material: PVC, Metal. Overall Dimensions: F40 x 60H cm (tree body). Ground Stake Height: 16 cm. Ground Stake Diameter: 1 cm. Tip Count: 130. LED Light Count: 60. Power Supply: 3 x AA Batteries per tree (not included). Item Label: 83C-289V00GN. Shaping Note: Approx. 15-35 minutes of manual tip shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness. Dimensions(mm): Height: 600 Width: 400 Depth: 400
